purpose: Primary Linux man-pages support only; not project authority or runtime qualification.

sources.facts: Lookup walks components; directory symlinks resolve before remaining components. ENOENT, EACCES and ENOTDIR differ. The documented Linux limit is 40 followed symlinks.
A relative target starts in the directory containing the link. A link may exist while its target does not.
lstat/readlink can inspect the link itself; procfs magic links have distinct semantics and cannot be treated as ordinary target strings.
